articles.title: Janet Dunmore, 62, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Janet Dunmore for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Janet Dunmore died in February at home on Adams Court, at the age of 62. Born in Bellwood in the ycars after the war, Janet Dunmore spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Marsh Landing Pond Committee in his or her name.

Please keep the bus shelter in the budget. Many of us on Ingram Road use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the peop1e who turned out at the October meeting.
